nested_session_prevention.description: Claude Code cannot be launched inside another Claude Code session. The CLAUDECODE environment variable is set, preventing nested agent execution.
nested_session_prevention.workaround: Execute tests manually outside Claude Code session

manual_execution_instructions: 1. Close Claude Code session (or open a separate terminal without CLAUDECODE env var)
2. Start Electron app: cd apps/frontend && ELECTRON_MCP_ENABLED=true npm run dev
3. Run integration tests: cd apps/backend && ELECTRON_MCP_ENABLED=true ELECTRON_MCP_MODE=embedded python test_llm_mcp_integration.py
4. Review test output and verify all 5 tests pass
